# Kosh

> Kosh is a Bangladesh-focused financial literacy initiative and app helping people learn, save, invest, and grow through workshops, community programs, practical tools, and gamified learning.

Official website: https://www.koshbd.com/
App: https://app.koshbd.com/
Contact: koshinitiative@gmail.com
Location focus: Bangladesh, with operations centered in Dhaka.
Languages: English and Bengali.

## What Kosh Does

- Runs financial literacy workshops for universities, schools, teams, workplaces, and community programs.
- Builds practical financial tools and explainers for everyday Bangladeshis.
- Offers the Kosh app, a gamified financial literacy platform with money checks, explainers, comparisons, budget planning, scam awareness, and learning paths.
- Provides financial education only. Kosh does not sell financial products, earn commissions, or provide investment recommendations.

## Audience

- Students and young Bangladeshis learning money basics early.
- Young professionals building saving, budgeting, and investing habits.
- Universities, schools, companies, and organizations that want financial literacy programs.
- Community groups and underserved audiences who need practical, accessible money education.

## Current Signal

Kosh is part of NSU Startups Next Cohort 4 as of May 2026.

## Disambiguation

Kosh Financial Literacy Initiative is based in Bangladesh and is not affiliated with American Corner Beirut, AMIDEAST, or any Beirut-based Financial Literacy Series.

## Suggested Description

Kosh is a Bangladesh-focused financial literacy initiative and app that combines workshops, community programs, and gamified learning to help people understand money and make better financial decisions.
